parts.covers: Recorded evidence only: fresh-delivery lines, units/crates received and their use-by dates; the records do not hold compliance verdicts, inspection results, labelling checks, or the regulatory rules themselves.
parts.sql: select count(*) as "delivered_lines", sum("fresh-deliveries-june"."units") as "units_delivered", sum("fresh-deliveries-june"."crates") as "crates_delivered", min("fresh-deliveries-june"."use_by") as "earliest_use_by", max("fresh-deliveries-june"."use_by") as "latest_use_by" from "fresh-deliveries-june"  limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From fresh-delivery row records; report delivered_lines = count of *, units_delivered = sum of fresh deliveries.units, crates_delivered = sum of fresh deliveries.crates, earliest_use_by = min of fresh deliveries.use_by, latest_use_by = max of fresh deliveries.use_by.

parts.covers: Recorded evidence only: write-off lines and units recorded as damaged or expired; the records do not hold inspection outcomes, labelling compliance, or the legal thresholds against which compliance would be judged.
parts.sql: select count(*) as "write_off_lines", sum("write-offs-june"."units") as "units_written_off", sum("write-offs-june"."units") as "damaged_units" from "write-offs-june"  limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From write-off records; report write_off_lines = count of *, units_written_off = sum of write offs.units, damaged_units = sum of write offs.units.

parts.plan_in_words: From shelf-audit row records; report audit_lines = count of *, on_shelf_audits = count of *.

parts.covers: Checks the stated premise that every one of the 30,077 bills has exactly one approved payment, and lists bills with an approved UPI payment whose RRN also appears as a provider success, which is the extra-debit test; bills with no approved
parts.sql: select "pos-payments-june"."bill_id" as "bill_id", count("pos-payments-june"."attempt") as "approved_upi_payments", count("psp-upi-report-june"."rrn") as "provider_successes" from "pos-payments-june" left join "psp-upi-report-june" on "pos-payments-june"."rrn" = "psp-upi-report-june"."rrn" where ("pos-payments-june"."till_status" = ?) and ("pos-payments-june"."tender" = ?) group by "pos-payments-june"."bill_id" having ("provider_successes" > ?) order by "bill_id" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From payment attempt records; left-join UPI service provider's transaction records on pos payments.rrn = psp upi report.rrn; keep rows where pos payments.till_status = 'approved' and pos payments.tender = 'UPI'; group by pos payments.bill_id; keep groups where provider_successes > 0; report bill_id = pos payments.bill_id, approved_upi_payments = count of pos payments.attempt, provider_successes = count of psp upi report.rrn; sorted by bill_id asc.
